report_text:
POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Aditya Gupta | Age: 48
Body Temperature at Scene: 27.1°C | Ambient Temperature: 27.2°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 6.9 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Facial: Periorbital ecchymosis bilateral [MODERATE]
  2. Cranial: Blunt force trauma with {severity} fracture [SEVERE]
  3. Thoracic: Multiple rib fractures with internal hemorrhage [SEVERE]
  4. Lower Limb: Multiple contusions consistent with assault [MILD]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): Ketamine, Opiates, Carbon Monoxide

RIGOR MORTIS: Partial rigor — early stage.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed posterior — no repositioning detected.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a premeditated assault by an attacker known to the victim. Toxicological findings suggest victim was sedated prior to the fatal assault.
